global_sequence_description: Surveillance footage of a clothing store where a synthetic subject inspects a folded garment and places it back onto the display rack.

chronological_sequence_segments.scene_description: The subject stands in the aisle carrying a white tote bag on their left shoulder, holding a folded black garment in both hands and inspecting it.
The subject turns their torso slightly toward the shelving unit, lifts the black garment with both hands, and sets it cleanly onto the wooden display shelf.
The subject releases the garment entirely, drops both hands to their sides, and begins to walk casually down the center of the aisle.
